hot_aisle.vm_terms: Minute billing; newly allocated compute. Existing eligible running allocations may retain $1.99; that rate is excluded here.
hot_aisle.bare_metal_terms: Whole-node allocation; one-month minimum. $27.12 per full node-hour before any additional charges.

nebius_ai_cloud.scope: AI Cloud on-demand list prices, not Token Factory Dedicated Endpoint prices. Per-GPU normalization does not establish available allocation sizes, stock or an equivalent managed service. Storage, taxes and contract/spot discounts are not inferred.

assumptions: Compare identical output units and the same acceptance and latency criteria.
Use every billable GPU and the complete paid interval, including paid setup and idle time.
The comparison excludes unentered costs and never proves readiness, quality, capacity availability or service equivalence.
User-entered throughput remains an unverified scenario input. A checkbox is not external verification.
